description: This file defines the MarketplaceReportingClient class used to interact with AWS Marketplace Reporting Service, extending the AwsClient class. It provides methods for retrieving buyer dashboard data synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: MarketplaceReportingClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS Marketplace Reporting Service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: getBuyerDashboard
methods.description: Synchronous method to retrieve the buyer dashboard data from AWS Marketplace Reporting Service.

methods.name: getBuyerDashboardAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to retrieve the buyer dashboard data, returning a promise.
